verdicts.note: 'Restoring ... proper funding for the Sheriff's Office' [S5] and 'properly staffed, supported, and equipped' [S1] are requests to fund his own department, not a general invest-and-expand position. The same Priorities page [S3] has a 'Fiscal Responsibility' plank ('transparent stewardship of taxpayer dollars', being 'honest about challenges'). The direction holds, but the signals are mixed and indirect, so medium is overstated.
